name: Kyomusume Koku Tokouki 2
source:
Fall in love with giant girls! The Gulliver's Tr*vels fan-fiction sequel for size fetishists continues! 

Mamesuke joined Gulliver as they set sail for home (Japan). 
Strong winds blew them off-course to the luxurious island of Brobdingnag, where 
they were welcomed by beautiful women 12 times the size of an average human! 

The year is now 1710 A.D., and one year has passed. 
Whilst feeling trapped and uneasy, Mamesuke meets a refreshingly free female 
pirate named Mary Reed. He joins her, along with four giant women, and 
returns to Japan at last... 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE087583.html]DLsite English[/url]]
